name: ccdebugger-info
experiment:
# Real CC-Debugger + CC2530 target, read-only: records the probe and target
# identification as timed steps. Nothing here erases, programs or resets.
#
#   make build && ./bin/hwlab run examples/ccdebugger-info.yaml
name: ccdebugger-info
duration: 3s

devices:
  dbg:
    plugin: ccdebugger

steps:
  - {name: identify, at: 100ms, device: dbg, call: DebugProbe.info}
  - {name: mac, at: 1500ms, device: dbg, call: DebugProbe.read_mac}
